card.name: Linking words in Middle East geography
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, the, through) and word-middles inside text about the Arabian Peninsula, Gulf, Iran, Afghanistan or nearby regions. It fires where the next word is likely a Middle Eastern or South Asian place name.

modes.label: Linking words in regional geography
modes.description: Words like of, and, the, through right before a place name in Gulf, Arabian or Asian geography.
modes.example: the sultanate of Oman occupies the southeastern edge<< of>> the Arabian Peninsula between Yemen to the southwest

modes.label: Inside Latin species names
modes.description: Partway through Latin animal or plant names for species found in the Middle East or South Asia.

modes.label: Time zone code
modes.description: The plus sign in a UTC offset for Arabia Standard Time.

card.writes: It pushes toward Middle Eastern country and region names (Iran, Arabia, Afghanistan, Egypt, Syria, Iraq) and away from Japanese and some US place names.
card.plain: It notices text set in the Middle East and Gulf region and prepares the model to name a country there.
